breaking_changes.BC_description: Chalk now requires Node.js version 4 or later. Attempting to use Chalk in earlier Node.js versions will result in runtime errors or incompatibility.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method:
Upgrade the Node.js runtime to version 4 or later before using Chalk v2.0.0.

Before (Node.js <4):
# Not supported

After (Node.js >=4):
$ node --version
v4.0.0
// Your code can safely require('chalk')

breaking_changes.BC_description: The method 'chalk.hasColor()' has been removed. Clients must now use the external 'has-ansi' package as a replacement API.
The method 'chalk.stripColor()' has been removed. Clients must now use the external 'strip-ansi' package as a replacement API.
The property 'chalk.styles' has been removed. Clients must instead use the external 'ansi-styles' package to access style information.
